title: Which Planet Has a Day Longer Than Its Year?
description:
One planet finishes a year before it finishes one rotation: Venus.

One rotation day takes about 243 Earth days, while one orbit year takes only 225. On Venus, the slow retrograde rotation means the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east.
